title: Evaluating Parenting Styles and Attachment Vignettes
description: Analyze clinical case vignettes of child-parent interactions to identify attachment and Baumrind styles.
problemStatement:
Read three family interaction vignettes involving bedtime routines and disciplinary conflicts.

### Requirements:
1. Categorize each parent's approach into Diana Baumrind's four styles (Authoritative, Authoritarian, Permissive, or Neglectful).
2. Predict the infant or child's likely Strange Situation attachment classification (Secure, Insecure-Avoidant, Insecure-Resistant, or Disorganized).
3. Outline the empirical long-term developmental trajectory for emotional regulation and academic resilience associated with each style.
hints: Hint 1: Authoritative parenting combines high responsiveness with demanding expectations.
Hint 2: Inconsistent or unpredictable caregiving often breeds insecure-ambivalent attachment.
